messages.en:
{07 0b 00}{01 00 00 05 00}What's your favorite walking
route, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?{02 01 00 08 09 0a}
City streets.
Jungle paths.
Spacious parks.
messages.et:
{07 0b 00}{01 00 00 05 00}Mis on su lemmik
jalutusrada, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?{02 01 00 08 09 0a}
Linnatänavad.
Džunglirajad.
Avarad pargid.

messages.en:
{07 16 00}Well, {04 1f 00},{01 00 00 05 00} don't
expect me to escort you,{01 00 00 0a 00}
{04 02 00}!
{07 1b 00}If you want to walk with
me, you'll have to chase me
down or bring me bananas.
messages.et:
{07 16 00}Noh, {04 1f 00},{01 00 00 05 00} ära oota,
et ma sind saadan,{01 00 00 0a 00}
{04 02 00}!
{07 1b 00}Kui tahad minuga jalutada,
pead mind taga ajama või
banaane tooma.

messages.en:
{01 00 00 0a 00}{07 1b 00}{01 00 00 05 00}I've been so busy lately
that {07 17 00}just going for a nice
walk like this is a treat{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
messages.et:
{01 00 00 0a 00}{07 1b 00}{01 00 00 05 00}Olen viimasel ajal nii
hõivatud, et {07 17 00}selline mõnus
jalutuskäik on juba pidu{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.

messages.en:
{07 15 00}I'm not just out here
walking,{01 00 00 0a 00} {04 02 00}! No,
I've got serious business.
{07 0a 00}I'm checking to see if
anyone dropped a
{04 15 00}!
messages.et:
{07 15 00}Ma ei ole siin lihtsalt
jalutamas,{01 00 00 0a 00} {04 02 00}! Ei,
mul on tõsine asjaajamine.
{07 0a 00}Kontrollin, kas keegi on
maha pillanud
{04 15 00}!

messages.en:
{07 0e 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}Hmmm{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 0f 00} I thought I had
something I needed to do.{01 00 00 0a 00}
But maybe{01 00 00 0a 00} I didn't.
{01 00 00 0a 00}{07 1b 00}{01 00 00 05 00}Whenever I'm out walking,{01 00 00 05 00} I
always half-remember stuff
I totally forgot.
messages.et:
{07 0e 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}Hmmm{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 0f 00} Arvasin, et mul
on midagi vaja teha.{01 00 00 0a 00}
Aga ehk{01 00 00 0a 00} polnudki.
{01 00 00 0a 00}{07 1b 00}{01 00 00 05 00}Alati kui jalutan,{01 00 00 05 00} meenub
mulle poolikult see, mille
olin täiesti unustanud.

messages.en:
{07 14 00}When I'm walking around like
this,{01 00 00 0a 00} I start thinking
about difficult things.
{07 00 00}Like this one time{01 00 00 0a 00}, I
dropped my sandwich in a
puddle. {01 01 00}{07 09 00}It {01 00 00 0a 00}scarred me.{07 00 00}
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Kui ma niimoodi ringi
jalutan,{01 00 00 0a 00} hakkan mõtlema
rasketele asjadele.
{07 00 00}Näiteks kord{01 00 00 0a 00} pillasin oma
võileiva lompi. {01 01 00}{07 09 00}See {01 00 00 0a 00}jättis
jälje.{07 00 00}

messages.en:
{07 19 00}Yeah, walking along streets
lined with skyscrapers{01 00 00 0a 00} is
so cool!{07 00 00}
{07 0d 00}You're just waiting for a
superhero to fly down and
swoop you up,{01 00 00 0a 00} {04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 19 00}Jah, jalutada tänavatel
pilvelõhkujate vahel{01 00 00 0a 00} on
nii lahe!{07 00 00}
{07 0d 00}Ootad, et superkangelane
alla lendaks ja su
kaasa haaraks,{01 00 00 0a 00} {04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 04 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}Oh!{01 00 00 14 00}{07 0d 00} You like oppressively
dense air dripping with the
lush scent of foliage!
{07 14 00}Yeah.{01 00 00 05 00} That just washes away
the stress.{01 00 00 0a 00} I mean, I
imagine it would.
messages.et:
{07 04 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}Oh!{01 00 00 14 00}{07 0d 00} Sulle meeldib rõhuv
tihe õhk, mis tilgub
lopsakast lehelõhnast!
{07 14 00}Jah.{01 00 00 05 00} See uhub stressi
lihtsalt minema.{01 00 00 0a 00} Ma arvan,
et uhuks.

messages.en:
{07 14 00}Yeah, {01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}.{01 00 00 14 00} Leisurely
walks are best done in a
park. Alone. With cookies.
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Jah, {01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}.{01 00 00 14 00} Rahulik
jalutus on parim pargis.
Üksi. Küpsistega.

messages.en:
{07 14 00}Whenever I'm walking,{01 00 00 0a 00} I can
forget everything that's
bothering me{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
{07 00 00}Each step{01 00 00 0a 00} makes me feel
lighter and lighter, {01 00 00 14 00}until
finally, {07 0a 00}I'm just flying!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Alati kui jalutan,{01 00 00 0a 00} suudan
unustada kõik, mis mind
vaevab{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
{07 00 00}Iga samm{01 00 00 0a 00} teeb mind
aina kergemaks, {01 00 00 14 00}kuni
lõpuks {07 0a 00}ma lihtsalt lendan!
